about: Process plan for the L&L gripper jaw (Greiferbacke, 1007223) on the shop's Haas VF-2 with a 6 in vise. Written by Claude from the drawing (314-092-59983-10) and the STEP model; every feature below is checked against the model by moonshot/planning/validate.py. Model frame: X is width (49), Y is height (the Y=40 face is the top, with the dowel counterbores), Z is length (75, centred). In section it is a T: a 10 mm flange on top, the stem (X 24 to 35) down to Y=0, an R10 between the flange and the stem's left side, and steps at Y 20 and 27 under the flange's right side. The top and the flange's outline are cut first, so Op 20 can hold the part by its flange in soft jaws while it cuts everything underneath.

stock.from: sawn from the bar on the band saw

faces.-X: on its edge, the stem's side up

operations.what: Cut the 3-1/4 in blank from the bar

workholding.note: The blank on 1 in parallels; the jaws hold its lowest 18.7 mm, so the flange's edges and the ends are profiled down to 1 mm above them and Op 20 cuts the rest

wcs.x: the centre of the blank's length
wcs.by: edge finder in X and Y; tool setter for Z

operations.what: Profile the flange's two edges and both ends to 49 x 75, down to the jaws

operations.note: The H drill, 6.76 mm, is inside Ø6.6's ±0.2

operations.what: Mill the two Ø10.000 H7 (+0.015/0) counterbores 3.2 deep
Chamfer the three top edges 5 x 45° and the counterbores 0.5 x 45°

workholding.note: Flipped onto the faced top, on 1.375 in parallels, in soft jaws cut to the flange's two edges: they hold its top 9 mm, so the flange's underside stands 0.9 mm above them. Cutting the soft jaws to the flange isn't a step yet, as for nist-ftc-10's Op 30

wcs.z: the top on the parallels, plus 40 mm

operations.what: Face the stem to the 40 mm height
Rough and finish the stem's sides, the steps at 20 and 27 mm, the flange's underside at 30 mm and the rest of both ends
Mill the R10 between the stem and the flange
Drill the flat-bottomed Ø11 up the stem, 30 deep, to meet the Ø6.6

workholding.note: On the flange's 8 mm edge on the vise floor against the stop, the jaws on its finished ends; check the stem's side is square with the indicator

operations.what: Spot the four holes and countersink the two clearance holes Ø9.5 x 90°

finish.what: Deburr every edge, breaking each sharp corner 0.2 x 45° (note 1) with a hooked blade drawn along it, and clean the M4 threads' exits

finish.title: Send it out for zinc plating
finish.what: Tag the part for zinc and trivalent chromate with the two Ø10 H7 bores and the M4 threads masked, so the plating can't close them, and set it on the outside-process rack's coating shelf for the vendor
Zinc plate with a trivalent chromate, all over but the masked bores and threads, by the outside vendor

finish.title: Check the bores, threads and plating
finish.what: Check the 75, 49 and 40 sizes with the calipers, the Ø10.000 H7 counterbores with gauge pins, the M4 threads with a go/no-go gauge, and the plating all over
